Shohei Ohtani Has Something Max Muncy Wants ⚾ #TeacupConfessions #Disneyland
Los Angeles Dodgers Max Muncy joins Teacup Confessions for a rapid-fire round of baseball and Disney questions on Mad Tea Party at Disneyland Park! ☕⚾🏰

Max shares:
⚾ His favorite MLB ballparks outside of Dodger Stadium
🔥 The toughest pitcher he's ever faced
👀 What fans don't realize about hitting in the Major Leagues
🦄 The skill he'd steal from Shohei Ohtani
🏆 Why the 2025 World Series title was especially meaningful
🎵 His Disney-themed walk-up song
🌭 Disneyland Corn Dog vs. Dodger Dog
✨ What becoming the first Dodgers third baseman selected to start an All-Star Game in nearly 50 years means to him
